name: Over-24h Teams incident alert and conditional site attachment
remarks: Condition-based file generation and Teams alert flow; site attachment used for multi-site incidents.

name: Multi-site alert summary and impacted-province grouping
remarks: Clean titles, Number of Sites Impacted, hub-site impact and grouped province summaries replace long repeated site-code text.

name: Impacted-sites Excel attachment formatting
remarks: No automatic table filters or banner title; no-wrap cells, content-based widths and regular Huawei Sans. Existing Telegram delivery remains separate.

name: Threaded restoration reply and source timestamp rules
remarks: NOC/manual uses Created At to Closed At; alarm source uses Issue Occurred At. Restoration reply follows the original incident thread.

name: Actual Root Cause and Resolution restoration fields
remarks: Restoration Root Cause uses Actual Root Cause only; Action Recovery uses Resolution only. No fallback to suspected cause or note.

name: Alarm restoration changed to Cleared Alarm Received At
remarks: Alarm-source restoration now uses the cleared-alarm receipt timestamp with start/end validation; manual/NOC rule remains unchanged.

name: Persistent alert ledger and five-minute checks
remarks: Incident-level delivery history survives restart; default down/restore checks are five minutes, with restore offset. Existing history prevents blanket resend.

name: Teams webhook configuration and VM update guidance
remarks: Checked configured down/restore flow identities. Channel selection remains inside Power Automate; webhook acceptance does not prove downstream completion.

name: Huawei Sans Bold for Telegram alert images
remarks: Site-down and shared INC-WO image renderers use Huawei Sans Bold; plain Telegram message font remains client-controlled.

name: VM Telegram test-launcher path repair
remarks: Shipped batch launchers use the retained scripts/send_telegram_test.py entry point; obsolete tests/manual path removed. No live send required for dry-run validation.

name: Huawei Sans across dashboard and form controls
remarks: Shared UI font applied to cards, tables, Partner Contact, Mentor, imports and explanatory popups.

name: Remove blur and shadows; unify 3px controls
remarks: Flat cards, buttons, dropdowns and tooltips use thin borders and consistent corners; chart/table styling preserved.

name: Bordered chart tooltips and action popups
remarks: Site Down age, weekly duration, Top Congestion and congestion-page tooltip/action surfaces use visible borders.

name: Sheet-style drilldown grids and rounded tables
remarks: Outer and cell borders, readable headers and 3px table frames; corrected unwanted stray lines.

name: Reusable empty-state SVG and real text
remarks: Compact no-data state uses transparent vector artwork and accessible real text rather than an image containing text.

name: Single-open filters and outside-click/Escape close
remarks: Shared dropdown behavior prevents multiple filters remaining open and contains scrolling inside the intended panel.

name: Root-cause percentage readability in light theme
remarks: Visible percentage and legend colors retained on light backgrounds instead of white-on-white text.

name: Weekly duration chart spacing and axis refinement
remarks: Adjusted plot position, labels, 500-step scale through 3K and legend gap; temporary 3.5K/4K ticks were removed.

name: Navigation and action SVG icon updates
remarks: Applied supplied icons for Mentor view, map, Partner Contact and Incident Report with consistent sizing.

name: Compact import card and site-code input redesign
remarks: Matched input/import cards, site-code chips, aligned borders and smaller monitoring badges.

name: CSV validation progress and completion status
remarks: Validation begins on file selection, shows progress for the requested interval, completion tick or failure, and stale-response protection.

name: CSV template, file-size and error validation
remarks: Rejects wrong template, empty/non-CSV/oversize file and unknown codes; input, upload and validation status remain distinct.

name: Site inventory validation for alphanumeric codes
remarks: Accepts valid site database codes, including supported I-prefixed identifiers; does not silently create unknown sites or POP monitoring.

name: Mentor view/action styling and combined down evidence
remarks: Compact supplied view icon and bordered action popups; active Site Down incidents can supplement missing alarm rows for monitored sites.

name: Persistent local congestion exclusions
remarks: Saved SQLite exclusions survive refresh and restart; restore removes a saved rule, not source alarm data.

name: Narrow exclusions to one device/interface
remarks: Owner plus device identity and interface define matching. Other interfaces and non-congestion alarms remain visible.

name: Optional exclusion remark and validation
remarks: Remark stored with the saved rule; interface reviewed in dialog and missing-interface records do not become broad device exclusions.

name: Expanded blacklist table and Restore workflow
remarks: Owner, device/site, IP, interface, additional info, note, remark, operator and Cambodia-time fields with per-entry Restore.

name: Consistent exclusions across counts and history
remarks: Current alarm lists, relevant badge counts, historical congestion views and exports apply interface-aware rules. Legacy rules without ports are inactive.

name: Blacklist popup request and layout hardening
remarks: Abort stale list requests; safe loading/error feedback, small headings, aligned buttons, bordered fields and supplied unboxed close icon.

name: All WO is Resolved badge and source-flag verification
remarks: One incident per qualifying result: non-closed parent, true source flag, at least one WO, and every linked WO strictly Resolved.

name: All-resolved incident drilldown and export
remarks: Total WOs, Resolved WOs and latest WO resolution shown per incident; no sibling status filtering before aggregation.

name: All-resolved cache refresh and table continuity
remarks: Scheduled incident snapshot refresh and periodic drilldown reload preserve search/scroll where supported.

name: All-resolved badge placement and labels
remarks: Badge moved below Overdue Site-Down; label All WO is Resolved and spacing below View controls updated.

name: Multi-site incident code caching and placeholders
remarks: Combine incident site fields, retain valid codes and leading zeroes, display multiple codes together; missing/question-only values render as underscore.

name: Customer Complaint active-status restriction
remarks: Only In Progress parents for the Customer Complaint category in applicable active incident/WO/all-resolved queries. Other categories and historical reporting keep their own rules.

name: Reconcile source flag versus actual sibling status
remarks: Read-only source comparison explained why Streamline true-flag counts can exceed strict all-WO-resolved results; cache freshness reviewed.

name: Response and Resolution Cambodia-week cutoffs
remarks: Aligned summary/detail reporting cutoff with Cambodia weeks; preserve the relevant per-metric date anchors.

name: SLA summary/detail reconciliation checks
remarks: Compared badge/summary cohorts with per-incident details, selected categories and correct occurrence/creation/closing week fields.

name: SLA root-cause failures: Response and Resolution
remarks: Root-cause breakdown includes incidents that miss either result; independent counts appear under Response Not Met and Resolution Not Met.

name: SLA root-cause matching drilldown and export
remarks: Each count opens its exact failure result and root cause with selected categories and occurrence week; shared incidents can appear once in each list.

name: Wider SLA popup with bordered example table
remarks: Three columns only: Root Cause Category, Response Not Met, Resolution Not Met. Wider responsive popup and shared outer/cell borders.

name: Smart Network report model and document exports
remarks: Smart Network report supports inventory/circuit data and matching DOCX/PDF document generation from saved report data.

name: Smart circuit single-value fill and multi-select
remarks: One available circuit fills automatically; two or more offer only actual available choices; deletion removes related dependent records.

name: Stable circuit association during rename
remarks: Preserve row/circuit identity through renames or temporary blanks instead of silently assigning another circuit.

name: Structural unsaved-report change tracking
remarks: Insert/delete row and user selection actions mark report dirty; clean initial load and save/reset behavior retained.

name: Chronology date grouping, insertion and sorting
remarks: Daily chronology headers, insert-below controls and live chronological ordering. Existing basic report template retained.

name: HEIC image normalization and Word PDF hardening
remarks: Phone-photo decoding before document embedding; Word automation security/fallback improvements verified in repository history.

name: Escape root-cause labels and notes in UI
remarks: Use safe text insertion for source-provided labels/notes rather than unescaped HTML.

name: Security response headers for no-login deployment
remarks: Added framing, nosniff and scoped CSP protections. No-login operation remains intentional; this is not a login feature.

name: Central source-system URL configuration
remarks: Shared URL helpers/configuration reduce repeated hardcoded hosts across services and templates.

name: Remove worklog columns from drilldown tables
remarks: Removed unneeded table worklog presentation while retaining the separate Site Down age worklog feature.

name: Cache projections and measured alarm-count optimization
remarks: Read only needed columns for badge counts; representative local benchmark showed reduced calculation cost. Not a VM load-test claim.

name: Retryable weekday popup loading errors
remarks: Validate HTTP response; show retryable inline failure and allow reload after failure instead of caching an error as success.

name: Request timing and performance diagnostics
remarks: Per-request method/path/status/duration logging and focused local browser/performance checks; no claim of guaranteed VM capacity.

name: Remove obsolete completed-test artifacts safely
remarks: Removed obsolete manual test copies/generated previews; scripts folder and automated regression suite were retained as requested.

name: Application regression and syntax validation
remarks: Full suite at V51 build: 596 passing tests; Python/JS/template syntax and Pyflakes checks passed. Later Help changes were checked separately.

name: Site/POP owner and coordinate interpretation
remarks: Verified site-status colors differ from POP-owner colors. Grey POP means blank/unrecognized owner; source query supplied for blank owners.

name: Latitude and Longitude in site and POP popups
remarks: Both marker types display existing coordinates to six decimals; zero handled correctly and invalid/missing values use underscore.

name: Full-width searchable Help landing page
remarks: Compact welcome/search, popular articles, grouped topics and preserved PDF links; fixed inherited flex-width gap.

name: Preserve original Help articles and PDF downloads
remarks: Restored all original articles, introduction and four PDFs after layout simplification; original documents remain available.

name: Separate article description pages
remarks: Topic links open their own readable page rather than one long accordion; Back navigation and unknown-topic handling verified.

name: Documentation sidebars and section navigation
remarks: Grouped topic tree with selected highlight/dots; central article and On this page anchors; mobile Browse guides control.

name: Consistent reading typography and inline highlights
remarks: Huawei Sans across text, lists, tables and inline labels; equal inline size with subtle highlight; visible color swatches restored.

name: Twenty detailed card-by-card guides
remarks: VIP/VVIP, Mentor, IP, RAN, incident/WO, trends, SLA, congestion and refresh guides with examples and plain-language rules.

name: Trend calculation recipes and worked tables
remarks: Calculation formulas, date boundaries, independent SLA failure lists and all-WO examples available in Help.

name: Expanded general Help descriptions
remarks: Thirteen existing topics supplemented with detailed workflows and troubleshooting while retaining original article text.

name: Reference-style equal Help topic cards
remarks: Equal-height cards, simple headings and guide lists, no colored panel background; See all docs opens topic pages.

name: Custom Help category and popular-guide SVGs
remarks: Applied supplied play, tower, cog, candlestick, headset, shield, crown, reply and numbered-file icons.

name: Practical action and feature usage guides
remarks: Eight guides explain Acknowledge/Modify Note, Exclude, Blacklist/Restore, Clear Alarm, filters/search, Mentor CSV, exports and report workflow.

name: Nine real-interface screenshot demonstrations
remarks: Screenshots captured with isolated sample fixtures and blocked writes. Small demo overlay text removed on request; captions retain illustrative context.

name: Help/PDF content parity and quick references
remarks: Worked SLA/WO tables, quick-start rules, glossary and verification checklist added to Help; source-code paths omitted.

name: Separate Detailed User Guide PDF
remarks: 62-page Huawei Sans guide for cards/calculations and practical topics; clickable contents/bookmarks and all pages checked.

name: Separate Feature Guide PDF with screenshots
remarks: 20-page action/feature guide containing nine screenshot placements; separate Help download link. Original four PDFs are unchanged.

name: Help route, asset and browser regression checks
remarks: Latest focused run: 79 passing tests; guide links, screenshots, example tables, desktop/mobile navigation, icons and PDF downloads checked.

name: Refresh V50 deployment and remove obsolete V51 copy
remarks: User-requested Nov-06 V50 package refresh and obsolete V51 removal completed at that time. A later Nov-10 V51 is a separate new build.

name: V51 complete build and archive integrity checks
remarks: Nov-10 V51 ZIP built: 367 runtime files, no real .env or instance data. All archived contents matched current build files. Later Help updates are not included.

name: Application-only VM update folders
remarks: Prepared reviewed changed-file sets, including a 48-file all-WO/SLA update folder; preserved folder structure for copy/replace deployment.

name: Document persistent instance and environment upgrades
remarks: Keep both .env and entire instance folder; live caches refresh normally while saved exclusions, Mentor selections and alert history persist. Stop old process before copying.

name: Frame 8 real-time/history dashboard design
remarks: Editable paired real-time and history design screens created in Figma using clearly identified sample data. Application implementation was not part of this design completion.

name: Frame 9 complete default dashboard design
remarks: Frame 9 remains unfinished after Figma tool quota blocked import/completion; local SVG/PNG fallback prepared. Do not report as delivered.

name: Mentor POP-code monitoring support
remarks: Explicitly deferred by user. Current Mentor validation/monitoring remains site-inventory based; accepting a POP code alone would not enable monitoring.

name: Dedicated hardware-fault and degraded-TX monitoring
remarks: Discussed requirement for faulty boards and degraded TX links. Dedicated widgets/rules and source reconciliation have not been implemented.

name: Separate real-time operations and history application tabs
remarks: Proposed dashboard organization exists in the design discussion; complete application migration has not been implemented.

name: RT fiber/backbone incident integration
remarks: Proposed integration only; no completed operational data feed is evidenced.

name: Source-confirmed Teams delivery completion
remarks: HTTP 2xx/202 only confirms webhook acceptance. Power Automate completion acknowledgment/run-history verification remains an external delivery limitation.

name: Semantic release-numbering migration
remarks: Version choices discussed, but user deferred the naming decision. Do not relabel V51 or claim a new semantic release was built.
